answer: Remove the free option from forecast accounts: before accepting a prediction, escrow its maximum possible loss under the scoring rule, and settle that escrow even if the key disappears. A sparrow model predicting island traffic across a bridge cannot keep winning aliases and abandon losing ones. Opposing predictions across ten accounts still pay every loss as well as collect every gain. A farm must fund all downside in advance, so throwing away keys cannot turn a losing strategy into free upside.
